title: ARIRANG World Tour Opens Two-Night AT&T Stadium Run in Arlington
detail: August 15, 2026 — BTS opened a sold-out two-night stand at AT&T Stadium (capacity ~80,000) in Arlington, Texas, the tour's third Texas stop after El Paso in May. Per setlist.fm, the show ran 2 hours 10 minutes (8:15-10:25 PM) across 24 songs, from opener 'Hooligan' through an encore of 'Come Over,' 'Butter,' 'Dynamite,' 'Permission to Dance,' 'Go Go,' 'Please,' and 'Into the Sun.' The show followed an overnight merch line that wrapped around nearby Choctaw Stadium the day before, with fans coping with a forecast high of 101°F. Concertgoers took part in the 'Texas ARMY Unites' fan project during the show. Night two follows Aug 16, after which the tour advances to Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23).

media.caption: BTS opens a sold-out two-night run at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas.
